name: IC Logic — 5V — TSSOP
description: Surface-mount logic IC cluster for 5V applications in TSSOP package options including TSSOP-20 and TSSOP-48 footprints.
selection_hints: Select when designing surface-mount 5V logic circuits requiring TSSOP packaging.
Choose based on required pin count and footprint, such as TSSOP-20 (0.65mm pitch) or TSSOP-48 (0.5mm pitch).
Verify part selection against representative Tier A parts such as LSF0108PW, MC74LCX16245DT, or SN74LVC245APW.
avoid_when: The design requires through-hole mounting rather than SMD TSSOP footprints.
The PCB footprint requirement differs from TSSOP-20 or TSSOP-48 packaging.
The application requires non-logic IC components.
